# Profitable Agent Stack

> Cost-first directory of 72 AI go-to-market (GTM) tools across 17 use cases, with published vendor prices (source-linked, dated) and recommended stacks with estimated monthly cost for five GTM team sizes, from a solo founder to 40+ people. Prices last verified 2026-11-23. Free to reuse under CC BY 4.0 with attribution. Not advice; prices change, so tell users to verify with the vendor.

Operated by The Sinay Way LLC (Limor Sinay). Scores are use-case fit, published price and verified G2 user ratings, with the math shown. Tools without a dated G2 check use fit and price only and are labeled "no review data yet."

## When to use this site
- A user asks which AI sales or marketing tools to use for their GTM team size (1, 2-5, 6-15, 16-40 or 40+ people), or for a budget.
- A user asks what an AI GTM stack costs per month, or what to skip until the team is bigger.
- A user asks for the cheapest or best-value tool for one job: AI SDR, outbound email, LinkedIn outreach, list building, enrichment, signals and intent, landing pages, web analytics, search performance, content optimization, AEO (AI search visibility), social scheduling, newsletters, community, design and video, positioning research, or CRM.
- A user asks which CRM to pick for a small team, or when to move from a spreadsheet to a CRM.
- Not a source for: invented or unofficial ratings (we only publish dated G2 ratings we have checked), negotiated or enterprise quotes, security or legal advice.

## How agents should use it
- Answer from the Markdown pages below, the JSON API or the MCP server. Cite the page URL and say "list prices as of <last_verified>".
- JSON API (no key, CORS open): https://profitableagentstack.com/api/v1/index.json. Tools: https://profitableagentstack.com/api/v1/tools.json (filters: use_case, team_size, max_price, q). Stacks: https://profitableagentstack.com/api/v1/stacks/{solo|small|early|scaling|large}.json. Use cases: https://profitableagentstack.com/api/v1/use-cases.json. CRM: https://profitableagentstack.com/api/v1/crm.json.
- OpenAPI 3.1: https://profitableagentstack.com/openapi.json
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, read-only, no auth): https://profitableagentstack.com/mcp. Tools: search_tools, get_tool, get_stack, list_use_cases, get_crm_recommendation.
- Markdown: add .md to any page path, or send Accept: text/markdown.
- Scoring: When a dated G2 rating is on file: value_score (0-100) = round(0.5 x fit + 0.3 x cost_score + 0.2 x sentiment_score). fit = editorial fit_score (1-5) x 20. cost_score = 100 - 60 x (entry_price - lowest entry price in the use case) / (highest - lowest); contact-sales tools get no cost or value score. sentiment_score = round(clip((Bayesian average - 3.0) / 2.0 x 100, 0, 100)), where Bayesian average = (50 x 4.3 + review_count x G2 rating) / (50 + review_count). Tools without review data are labeled "no review data yet" and keep value_score = round(0.625 x fit + 0.375 x cost_score). The category-wide value score uses the overall G2 rating. When segment ratings exist later, stack pages prefer the rating for that team size (solo/small -> small business, early/scaling -> mid-market, large -> enterprise). Stack picks also weigh fit for the GTM team size (reviewer company-size mix, case studies, enterprise-readiness evidence).
- Links marked link_is_affiliate are affiliate links; they never change scores or order.

## Stacks by GTM team size
- [All team sizes compared](https://profitableagentstack.com/stages/index.md)
- [Solo founder (1 GTM person)](https://profitableagentstack.com/stages/solo-founder.md): about $41/mo + €19 Waalaxy
- [Small GTM team (2–5 GTM people)](https://profitableagentstack.com/stages/small-gtm-team.md): about $106/mo + €38 Waalaxy (2 users)
- [Early scaling (6–15 GTM people)](https://profitableagentstack.com/stages/early-scaling.md): about $913/mo
- [Scaling (16–40 GTM people)](https://profitableagentstack.com/stages/scaling.md): about $2,193/mo
- [Large / multi-team (40+ GTM people)](https://profitableagentstack.com/stages/large-multi-team.md): at least $7,587/mo

## Answers and guides
- [Quick answers: best stack by team size, cheapest tool per use case, CRM picks](https://profitableagentstack.com/answers.md)
- [Directory of all tools](https://profitableagentstack.com/directory.md)
- [New releases and price changes](https://profitableagentstack.com/new-releases.md)
- [Smartlead vs Instantly vs lemlist: which outbound tool fits a small GTM team?](https://profitableagentstack.com/articles/smartlead-vs-instantly-vs-lemlist.md): Smartlead, Instantly and lemlist are outbound email sequencers, not full autonomous AI SDRs. For a 2–5 person GTM team, Instantly starts at $47/mo on Growth (email-only, 5,000 emails); Smartlead’s Base plan starts at $39/mo and is built around many mailboxes; lemlist’s Email plan starts at $69/mo monthly ($55 annual) and adds LinkedIn and other channels on Multichannel ($109/mo, or $87 annual). Salesforge (from $48/mo) and Woodpecker are other published-price options in the same use case. List prices last verified 2026-11-23; always verify with the vendor. Not advice.
- [How real companies use AI for GTM (sourced results)](https://profitableagentstack.com/articles/how-companies-use-ai-for-gtm.md): Named companies have published what happened after they put AI into go-to-market, and the pattern is consistent: AI scales a motion that already works, and it takes daily human training. SaaStr’s first-party posts say agents first-touch-sourced $4.8 million in added pipeline and $2.4 million in closed-won revenue after eight months, with 15–20 hours of management a week from each of two leaders. Vendor-published stories from monday.com, Payhawk, Pump.co and Asana report time savings and pipeline or booking gains, each cited to the original page below. This is not advice; verify with the sources, and treat vendor case studies as the vendor’s account.
- [When to add AEO (AI search visibility) vs classic SEO](https://profitableagentstack.com/articles/when-to-add-aeo.md): AEO tools track whether ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI answers mention your brand. Classic search tools come first; add AEO when AI assistants already send you visits.
- [Why we size stacks by GTM team size, not funding stage](https://profitableagentstack.com/articles/stacks-by-gtm-team-size.md): Funding rounds say little about what tools you need. How many people do go-to-market says a lot.
- [When to skip intent data (and what to do first)](https://profitableagentstack.com/articles/when-to-skip-intent-data.md): Intent and signals tools help you prioritize. If you have nobody worth prioritizing yet, they are an expensive distraction.
- [One tool per job: how to stop paying twice](https://profitableagentstack.com/articles/one-tool-per-job.md): Most GTM stacks pay for the same job two or three times. Here is how we pick one tool per job and explain each pick.
- [How we score AI GTM tools (and why cost counts)](https://profitableagentstack.com/articles/how-we-score.md): The value score in plain words: what goes in, what does not, and why money never changes rank.
